Remark
[injectivity radius via the cut locus]

Source: petersen:page-0236 ↗ def:pet-ch5-cut-locus ↗ def:pet-ch5-injectivity-radius In a complete manifold, $\operatorname {inj}(p)$ (the largest $\varepsilon $ with $\exp _p:B(0,\varepsilon )\to B(p,\varepsilon )$ a diffeomorphism) equals $|v|$ for $v$ the closest point of the cut locus $\operatorname {seg}(p)-\operatorname {seg}^0(p)$ to the origin.
